provenance.typography.pairing: A technical pairing is the instrument's voice; the tenant's own faces stay brand-class and unreachable from here.
provenance.typography.scale: A slightly smaller type step packs more record per screen, inside every vertical's type range.
provenance.typography.role-weights: Strong role weights keep a dense table scannable.
provenance.typography.numeric: Tabular figures keep columns of numbers aligned.
provenance.shape.radius-scale: Tight corners at the floor of every vertical's radius range read as a tool, not a card deck.
provenance.shape.nesting: Uniform nesting keeps inner corners as tight as the outer ones.
provenance.shape.button-style: Sharp buttons follow the radius posture rather than restating it.
provenance.shape.control-height: Compact controls are the posture's density statement.
provenance.density.mode: Compact density sizes the controls for an operator's working set.
provenance.spacing.rhythm: A tight rhythm shrinks the room around the controls to match.
provenance.surfaces.elevation-posture: Soft elevation separates layers without lifting them off the page.
provenance.surfaces.border-style: Strong borders are the ruled edges the posture reads by.
provenance.surfaces.effect-intensity: Effects stay low so the data carries the screen.
provenance.states.emphasis: Decisive state emphasis makes a selection unmistakable in a dense view.
provenance.states.focus-style: A ring focus is the most legible indicator at compact sizes.
provenance.motion.dial: Short, low-intensity motion: an instrument responds, it does not perform.
provenance.motion.character: Mechanical motion matches the instrument's register.
provenance.navigation.sidebar-tone: An inverse sidebar anchors the operator's navigation; it picks steps of the tenant's own ramps and carries no colour of its own.
provenance.profiles.expressive: The technical expressive profile states the sharp geometry, outlined edges and micro-grid motif as one posture.
provenance.recipe-profile: The technical-sharp recipe is the component recipe that posture assumes.
provenance.chrome.anatomy: Framed cards, zebra tables and a rail sidebar are the dense anatomy.
provenance.responsive.posture: A compact responsive posture keeps the density at narrow widths.
